youtube.title: What if you were a leech collector for one day?
youtube.description:
1832: doctors want leeches for almost everything – and the cheapest bait is your bare legs. 🪱🦵 You wade into a marsh pond, let them bite, peel them off into a jar and sell them for barely anything. One of the worst jobs in history… and hospitals still use medicinal leeches today.
Would you wade in? A) Sure, not squeamish B) Only in boots C) Absolutely not – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: Büşra Arabacı, "'Pearls' of the nineteenth century: medicinal leeches in the Ottoman Empire", Medical History 67(2), 2023 (France imported 57.5 million leeches in 1832); Science History Institute, Distillations, "Medicinal Leeches and Where to Find Them"; U.S. FDA 510(k) K040187 (medicinal leeches cleared as a medical device, June 2004)
